description: This line plot illustrates the Pass@1 rate (%) for the GPT-4o model as a function of the number of reasoning steps, ranging from 5 to 40 steps on a linear x-axis. The y-axis, labeled "Pass@1 Rate (%)", scales linearly from 0 to 100. The plot displays two distinct lines: a solid blue line with circular markers representing the GPT-4o model, and a dashed light blue line with cross markers representing a baseline or alternative method. The GPT-4o line begins at 6.5% at 5 steps, rises to 32.3% at 10 steps, then increases more steeply to 77.4% at 20 steps, and finally reaches 83.9% at 40 steps. The baseline line starts at 19.4% at 5 steps, rises to 38.7% at 10 steps, then increases more gradually to 87.1% at 20 steps, and finally reaches 89.2% at 40 steps. Both lines show a general upward trend with the baseline consistently outperforming GPT-4o across all step counts shown.
